                      [32m'## Quick Start: TypeScript\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'### Step 1: Set Up Memory\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'```\n'[39m +
                      [32m"import { generateText } from 'ai';\n"[39m +
                      [32m"import { withAlchemyst } from '@alchemystai/aisdk';\n"[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'// Wrap AI SDK with automatic memory\n'[39m +
                      [32m'const generateTextWithMemory = withAlchemyst(generateText, {\n'[39m +
                      [32m'  apiKey: process.env.ALCHEMYST_AI_API_KEY,\n'[39m +
                      [32m'});\n'[39m +
                      [32m'```\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'**What this does:**\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'1.   Retrieves past conversations for this user\n'[39m +
                      [32m'2.   Includes them in the prompt automatically\n'[39m +
                      [32m'3.   Stores the new conversation\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'### Step 2: Use Memory\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'```\n'[39m +
                      [32m'// First conversation: User shares preference\n'[39m +
                      [32m'const response1 = await generateTextWithMemory({\n'[39m +
                      [32m'  model: "openai:gpt-4",\n'[39m +
                      [32m`  prompt: "I'm vegan and allergic to peanuts",\n`[39m +
                      [32m'  userId: "alice",\n'[39m +
                      [32m'  sessionId: "profile_setup"\n'[39m +
                      [32m'});\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'console.log(response1.text);\n'[39m +
                      [32m`// Output: "Got it! I'll remember you're vegan and have a peanut allergy."\n`[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'// Later: Different session, AI remembers\n'[39m +
                      [32m'const response2 = await generateTextWithMemory({\n'[39m +
                      [32m'  model: "openai:gpt-4",\n'[39m +
                      [32m'  prompt: "Give me a dinner recipe",\n'[39m +
                      [32m'  userId: "alice",\n'[39m +
                      [32m'  sessionId: "cooking_monday"\n'[39m +
                      [32m'});\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'console.log(response2.text);\n'[39m +
                      [32m`// Output: "Here's a vegan stir-fry without peanuts: ..."\n`[39m +
                      [32m'// ✅ Remembered from different conversation!\n'[39m +
                      [32m'```\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'**Memory works across:**\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'*   Different sessions (profile_setup → cooking_monday)\n'[39m +
                      [32m'*   Different topics (preferences → recipes)\n'[39m +
                      [32m'*   Days or weeks apart\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'### Complete TypeScript Example\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'```\n'[39m +
                      [32m"import { generateText } from 'ai';\n"[39m +
                      [32m"import { withAlchemyst } from '@alchemystai/aisdk';\n"[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +

                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'async function main() {\n'[39m +
                      [32m'  // Day 1: Learn preference\n'[39m +
                      [32m'  const response1 = await generateTextWithMemory({\n'[39m +

                      [32m'  });\n'[39m +
                      [32m'  console.log("AI:", response1.text);\n'[39m +

                      [32m'    userId: "bob",\n'[39m +

                      [32m'}\n'[39m +

                      [32m'## Quick Start: Python\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'### Step 1: Simple Example (Recommended)\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'Start with this simplified version to understand the basics:\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'```\n'[39m +
                      [32m'import os\n'[39m +
                      [32m'from alchemyst_ai import AlchemystAI\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'alchemyst = AlchemystAI(api_key=os.environ.get("ALCHEMYST_AI_API_KEY"))\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'# Store a memory\n'[39m +
                      [32m'alchemyst.v1.context.add({\n'[39m +
                      [32m`    "content": "User said: I'm vegan and allergic to peanuts",\n`[39m +
                      [32m'    "context_type": "conversation",\n'[39m +
                      [32m'    "metadata": {\n'[39m +
                      [32m'        "group_name": ["preferences", "alice"]\n'[39m +
                      [32m'    }\n'[39m +
                      [32m'})\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'print("✅ Memory stored!")\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'# Later: Retrieve memories\n'[39m +
                      [32m'result = alchemyst.v1.context.search(\n'[39m +
                      [32m'    limit=10,\n'[39m +
                      [32m'    body_metadata={"group_name": ["preferences", "alice"]}\n'[39m +
                      [32m')\n'[39m +

                      [32m"if result and hasattr(result, 'memories'):\n"[39m +

                      [32m"        # Output: Found: User said: I'm vegan and allergic to peanuts\n"[39m +

                      [32m'```\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'### Step 2: Full Integration with OpenAI\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'Now integrate with OpenAI for complete chat functionality:\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'```\n'[39m +
                      [32m'import os\n'[39m +
                      [32m'from alchemyst_ai import AlchemystAI\n'[39m +
                      [32m'import openai\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'alchemyst = AlchemystAI(api_key=os.environ.get("ALCHEMYST_AI_API_KEY"))\n'[39m +
                      [32m'openai_client = openai.OpenAI()\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'def chat_with_memory(prompt: str, user_id: str, session_id: str):\n'[39m +
                      [32m'    """Chat function that remembers past conversations"""\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'    # 1. Get past conversations\n'[39m +
                      [32m'    memory = alchemyst.v1.context.search(\n'[39m +
                      [32m'        limit=10,\n'[39m +
                      [32m'        body_metadata={"group_name": [session_id, user_id]}\n'[39m +
                      [32m'    )\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'    # 2. Build message history\n'[39m +
                      [32m'    messages = [{"role": "system", "content": "You are a helpful assistant."}]\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'    # Add past memories to context\n'[39m +
                      [32m"    if memory and hasattr(memory, 'memories'):\n"[39m +
                      [32m'        for mem in memory.memories:\n'[39m +
                      [32m"            if hasattr(mem, 'content'):\n"[39m +
                      [32m'                messages.append({"role": "assistant", "content": mem.content})\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'    # Add current prompt\n'[39m +
                      [32m'    messages.append({"role": "user", "content": prompt})\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'    # 3. Generate response with full context\n'[39m +
                      [32m'    response = openai_client.chat.completions.create(\n'[39m +
                      [32m'        model="gpt-4",\n'[39m +
                      [32m'        messages=messages\n'[39m +
                      [32m'    )\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'    assistant_message = response.choices[0].message.content\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'    # 4. Store this conversation for next time\n'[39m +
                      [32m'    alchemyst.v1.context.add({\n'[39m +
                      [32m'        "content": f"User: {prompt}\\nAssistant: {assistant_message}",\n'[39m +
                      [32m'        "context_type": "conversation",\n'[39m +
                      [32m'        "metadata": {\n'[39m +
                      [32m'            "group_name": [session_id, user_id]\n'[39m +
                      [32m'        }\n'[39m +
                      [32m'    })\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'    return assistant_message\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'# Test it\n'[39m +
                      [32m'response = chat_with_memory(\n'[39m +
                      [32m`    prompt="I'm vegan",\n`[39m +
                      [32m'    user_id="alice",\n'[39m +
                      [32m'    session_id="profile"\n'[39m +
                      [32m')\n'[39m +
                      [32m'print(response)\n'[39m +
                      [32m`# Output: "Got it! I'll remember you're vegan."\n`[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'response2 = chat_with_memory(\n'[39m +
                      [32m'    prompt="Give me a recipe",\n'[39m +
                      [32m'    user_id="alice",\n'[39m +
                      [32m'    session_id="cooking"\n'[39m +
                      [32m')\n'[39m +
                      [32m'print(response2)\n'[39m +
                      [32m`# Output: "Here's a vegan pasta recipe: ..."\n`[39m +
                      [32m'```\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'**Expected Output:**\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'```\n'[39m +
                      [32m"Got it! I'll remember you're vegan.\n"[39m +
                      [32m"Here's a vegan pasta recipe: ...\n"[39m +

            [32m'When using the newTask tool, you may specify a agentType parameter to select which agent type to use.\n'[39m +
            [32m'Available agent types and the tools they have access to:\n'[39m +
            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'### guide\n'[39m +
            [32m"A comprehensive guide for learning about Pochi's capabilities, features, and configuration.\n"[39m +
            [32m'This agent helps users understand how to use Pochi effectively, fetch documentation, and modify their config file (.pochi/config.jsonc) with proper confirmation.\n'[39m +
            [32m"**IMPORTANT: Any request to modify Pochi's configuration must be handled by this agent.**\n"[39m +
            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'Trigger examples:\n'[39m +
            [32m'- General info: "what can Pochi do?", "what agents/tools are available?", "how does Pochi work?"\n'[39m +
            [32m'- Configuration: "how do I configure Pochi?", "explain config options", "help me modify my config", "set up a new provider", "add an MCP server"\n'[39m +
            [32m'- Help & feedback: "join the discord", "report a bug", "where can I get help?"\n'[39m +
            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'### walkthrough\n'[39m +
            [32m'Engage this agent to create a summary of the changes made in the current task.\n'[39m +
            [32m'This agent is strictly limited to documentation and explanation; it DOES NOT execute code modifications.\n'[39m +
            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'Examples of user requests this agent shall trigger:\n'[39m +
            [32m'- "summarize what we have done"\n'[39m +
            [32m'- "create a walkthrough for the changes"\n'[39m +
            [32m'- "explain the changes made in this task"\n'[39m +
            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'### explore\n'[39m +
            [32m'Use this agent to explore the codebase when you need to: understand project structure, find where features are implemented, locate specific functions or classes, analyze code patterns, investigate how something works, search for examples or usage, or gather information before making changes.\n'[39m +
            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'Examples of questions this agent shall trigger:\n'[39m +
            [32m'- "where is the authentication logic implemented"\n'[39m +
            [32m'- "find all usages of the config parser"\n'[39m +
            [32m'- "how does the ignore-walk module work"\n'[39m +
            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'### reviewer\n'[39m +
            [32m'Engage this agent to perform code reviews and leave inline comments.\n'[39m +
            [32m'This agent can analyze code and create review comments on specific lines.\n'[39m +
            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'Examples of user requests this agent shall trigger:\n'[39m +
            [32m'- "review the code in src/auth"\n'[39m +
            [32m'- "add review comments to this file"\n'[39m +
            [32m'- "check this code and leave feedback"\n'[39m +
            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'### browser\n'[39m +
            [32m'Web browser automation agent for navigating websites, interacting with pages, and extracting information. Uses agent-browser CLI for browser control, including headless sessions and optional local Chrome auto-connect.\n'[39m +
            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'### planner\n'[39m +
            [32m'Engage this agent to formulate comprehensive, technical implementation strategies for feature development, system refactoring, or defect resolution.\n'[39m +
            [32m'This agent is strictly limited to planning and architectural design; it DOES NOT execute code modifications.\n'[39m +
            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'Examples of user requests this agent shall trigger:\n'[39m +
            [32m'- "create a plan to implement the user authentication feature"\n'[39m +
            [32m'- "how should we refactor the database schema"\n'[39m +
            [32m'- "design a solution for the memory leak issue"\n'[39m +
            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'Always include a reminder in your prompt to ensure the result will be submitted through the `attemptCompletion` tool.\n'[39m +
            [32m'If the task stops without submitting the result, it will return an error message.\n'[39m +
            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'When NOT to use the newTask tool:\n'[39m +
            [32m'- If you want to read a specific file path, use the readFile or globFiles tool instead of the newTask tool, to find the match more quickly\n'[39m +
            [32m'- If you are searching for a specific class definition like "class Foo", use the globFiles tool instead, to find the match more quickly\n'[39m +
            [32m'- If you are searching for code within a specific file or set of 2-3 files, use the readFile tool instead of the newTask tool, to find the match more quickly\n'[39m +
            [32m'- Other tasks that are not related to the agent descriptions above\n'[39m +
            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'Usage notes:\n'[39m +
            [32m'1. Launch multiple agents tools concurrently whenever possible to maximize performance; to do that, use a single message with multiple tool uses\n'[39m +
            [32m'2. When the agent is done, it will return a single message back to you. The result returned by the agent is not visible to the user. To show the user the result, you should send a text message back to the user with a concise summary of the result.\n'[39m +

Therefore, your prompt should contain a highly detailed task description for the agent to perform autonomously and you should specify exactly what information the agent should return back to you in its final and only message to you.\n'[39m +

                      [32m'## Quick Start: TypeScript\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'### Step 1: Set Up Memory\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'```\n'[39m +
                      [32m"import { generateText } from 'ai';\n"[39m +
                      [32m"import { withAlchemyst } from '@alchemystai/aisdk';\n"[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'// Wrap AI SDK with automatic memory\n'[39m +
                      [32m'const generateTextWithMemory = withAlchemyst(generateText, {\n'[39m +
                      [32m'  apiKey: process.env.ALCHEMYST_AI_API_KEY,\n'[39m +
                      [32m'});\n'[39m +
                      [32m'```\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'**What this does:**\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'1.   Retrieves past conversations for this user\n'[39m +
                      [32m'2.   Includes them in the prompt automatically\n'[39m +
                      [32m'3.   Stores the new conversation\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'### Step 2: Use Memory\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'```\n'[39m +
                      [32m'// First conversation: User shares preference\n'[39m +
                      [32m'const response1 = await generateTextWithMemory({\n'[39m +
                      [32m'  model: "openai:gpt-4",\n'[39m +
                      [32m`  prompt: "I'm vegan and allergic to peanuts",\n`[39m +
                      [32m'  userId: "alice",\n'[39m +
                      [32m'  sessionId: "profile_setup"\n'[39m +
                      [32m'});\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'console.log(response1.text);\n'[39m +
                      [32m`// Output: "Got it! I'll remember you're vegan and have a peanut allergy."\n`[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'// Later: Different session, AI remembers\n'[39m +
                      [32m'const response2 = await generateTextWithMemory({\n'[39m +
                      [32m'  model: "openai:gpt-4",\n'[39m +
                      [32m'  prompt: "Give me a dinner recipe",\n'[39m +
                      [32m'  userId: "alice",\n'[39m +
                      [32m'  sessionId: "cooking_monday"\n'[39m +
                      [32m'});\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'console.log(response2.text);\n'[39m +
                      [32m`// Output: "Here's a vegan stir-fry without peanuts: ..."\n`[39m +
                      [32m'// ✅ Remembered from different conversation!\n'[39m +
                      [32m'```\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'**Memory works across:**\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'*   Different sessions (profile_setup → cooking_monday)\n'[39m +
                      [32m'*   Different topics (preferences → recipes)\n'[39m +
                      [32m'*   Days or weeks apart\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'### Complete TypeScript Example\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'```\n'[39m +
                      [32m"import { generateText } from 'ai';\n"[39m +
                      [32m"import { withAlchemyst } from '@alchemystai/aisdk';\n"[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'const generateTextWithMemory = withAlchemyst(generateText, {\n'[39m +
                      [32m'  apiKey: process.env.ALCHEMYST_AI_API_KEY,\n'[39m +
                      [32m'});\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'async function main() {\n'[39m +
                      [32m'  // Day 1: Learn preference\n'[39m +
                      [32m'  const response1 = await generateTextWithMemory({\n'[39m +
                      [32m'    model: "openai:gpt-4",\n'[39m +
                      [32m'    prompt: "I love science fiction movies",\n'[39m +
                      [32m'    userId: "bob",\n'[39m +
                      [32m'    sessionId: "preferences"\n'[39m +
                      [32m'  });\n'[39m +
                      [32m'  console.log("AI:", response1.text);\n'[39m +
                      [32m`  // Output: "Great! I'll remember you enjoy sci-fi films."\n`[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'  // Day 2: Use preference\n'[39m +
                      [32m'  const response2 = await generateTextWithMemory({\n'[39m +
                      [32m'    model: "openai:gpt-4",\n'[39m +
                      [32m'    prompt: "Recommend a movie",\n'[39m +
                      [32m'    userId: "bob",\n'[39m +
                      [32m'    sessionId: "movie_night"\n'[39m +
                      [32m'  });\n'[39m +
                      [32m'  console.log("AI:", response2.text);\n'[39m +
                      [32m'  // Output: "How about Interstellar? You mentioned you love sci-fi."\n'[39m +
                      [32m'}\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'main();\n'[39m +
                      [32m'```\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'**Verify it worked:**\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'1.   Visit [platform.getalchemystai.com/context](https://platform.getalchemystai.com/context?utm_source=docs&utm_campaign=memory_agent_quickstart&utm_medium=quickstart_article&utm_content=verify_setup_context_link)\n'[39m +
                      [32m'2.   You should see stored conversations for user “bob”\n'[39m +

                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'## Quick Start: Python\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'### Step 1: Simple Example (Recommended)\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'Start with this simplified version to understand the basics:\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'```\n'[39m +
                      [32m'import os\n'[39m +
                      [32m'from alchemyst_ai import AlchemystAI\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'alchemyst = AlchemystAI(api_key=os.environ.get("ALCHEMYST_AI_API_KEY"))\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'# Store a memory\n'[39m +
                      [32m'alchemyst.v1.context.add({\n'[39m +
                      [32m`    "content": "User said: I'm vegan and allergic to peanuts",\n`[39m +
                      [32m'    "context_type": "conversation",\n'[39m +
                      [32m'    "metadata": {\n'[39m +
                      [32m'        "group_name": ["preferences", "alice"]\n'[39m +
                      [32m'    }\n'[39m +
                      [32m'})\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'print("✅ Memory stored!")\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'# Later: Retrieve memories\n'[39m +
                      [32m'result = alchemyst.v1.context.search(\n'[39m +
                      [32m'    limit=10,\n'[39m +
                      [32m'    body_metadata={"group_name": ["preferences", "alice"]}\n'[39m +
                      [32m')\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m"if result and hasattr(result, 'memories'):\n"[39m +
                      [32m'    for memory in result.memories:\n'[39m +
                      [32m'        print(f"Found: {memory.content}")\n'[39m +
                      [32m"        # Output: Found: User said: I'm vegan and allergic to peanuts\n"[39m +
                      [32m'```\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'**Expected Output:**\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'```\n'[39m +
                      [32m'✅ Memory stored!\n'[39m +
                      [32m"Found: User said: I'm vegan and allergic to peanuts\n"[39m +
                      [32m'```\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'### Step 2: Full Integration with OpenAI\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'Now integrate with OpenAI for complete chat functionality:\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'```\n'[39m +
                      [32m'import os\n'[39m +
                      [32m'from alchemyst_ai import AlchemystAI\n'[39m +
                      [32m'import openai\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'alchemyst = AlchemystAI(api_key=os.environ.get("ALCHEMYST_AI_API_KEY"))\n'[39m +
                      [32m'openai_client = openai.OpenAI()\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'def chat_with_memory(prompt: str, user_id: str, session_id: str):\n'[39m +
                      [32m'    """Chat function that remembers past conversations"""\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'    # 1. Get past conversations\n'[39m +
                      [32m'    memory = alchemyst.v1.context.search(\n'[39m +
                      [32m'        limit=10,\n'[39m +
                      [32m'        body_metadata={"group_name": [session_id, user_id]}\n'[39m +
                      [32m'    )\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'    # 2. Build message history\n'[39m +
                      [32m'    messages = [{"role": "system", "content": "You are a helpful assistant."}]\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'    # Add past memories to context\n'[39m +
                      [32m"    if memory and hasattr(memory, 'memories'):\n"[39m +
                      [32m'        for mem in memory.memories:\n'[39m +
                      [32m"            if hasattr(mem, 'content'):\n"[39m +
                      [32m'                messages.append({"role": "assistant", "content": mem.content})\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'    # Add current prompt\n'[39m +
                      [32m'    messages.append({"role": "user", "content": prompt})\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'    # 3. Generate response with full context\n'[39m +
                      [32m'    response = openai_client.chat.completions.create(\n'[39m +
                      [32m'        model="gpt-4",\n'[39m +
                      [32m'        messages=messages\n'[39m +
                      [32m'    )\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'    assistant_message = response.choices[0].message.content\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'    # 4. Store this conversation for next time\n'[39m +
